summary.text: Barrie Ciliberti is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates for District 4 in Frederick County. His official page says he served in the House from 1995 to 1999 for District 39 in Montgomery County, was appointed in 2015, and has served since January 9, 2019 after the November 2018 election.

paragraphs.text: Ciliberti's official page says he was born in Philadelphia in 1936.
It lists a B.A. in history from Ursinus College in 1957, an M.A. in history from Georgetown University in 1960 and a Ph.D. in administration from Catholic University in 1975.
It lists him as an associate professor at Bowie State College of Education and an adjunct professor at the University of Maryland University College, and as married with five children.
The page lists his current assignment as the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee.
It says he served on the Appropriations Committee from 2015 to 2019 and on the Environment and Transportation Committee from 2019 to 2025.
